title: Consistency for the click counter
prompt: A URL shortener increments an analytics click counter on every redirect. Which consistency model fits best?
constraint: Latency-sensitive redirect path; slightly stale counts are acceptable.

options.why: Strong consistency forces coordination on the hottest path in the system for a metric that explicitly tolerates staleness — you'd add redirect latency to buy a guarantee you don't need.

Right call. Eventual consistency with async aggregation keeps the redirect fast, and the stated constraint says slightly stale counts are fine — fit-to-constraint, not cargo-culted strong consistency.
Defensible, but causal consistency is heavier machinery than a staleness-tolerant counter needs. Eventual is the cleaner fit here; reserve causal for ordering that actually matters.
